definitions.short: Oholah , a symbolic name for Samaria
definitions.full: H170. Oholah אָהֳלָה proper name, feminine Ohola (for אָהֳלָהּ she who has a tent, tent-woman , i.e. worshipper at tent-shrine, see Sm) of Samaria, adultress with Assyria Ezek 23:4 (twice in verse); 23:5 , 36 , 44 .
definitions.rootNote: in form a feminine of 168 , but in fact for אׇהֳלָהּ ; from 168 ; her tent (i.e. idolatrous sanctuary);

occurrences.englishText: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
“Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
Yahweh said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
